title: MUNDO: a multiresolution generative framework for temporal downscaling
abstract: arXiv:2611.30868v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dynamical systems are often observed at coarse temporal resolution through sparse states or temporal aggregates, leaving the underlying fine-scale trajectories unresolved. Recovering these trajectories requires probabilistic models that capture the unresolved variability while remaining consistent with the observations. We present MUNDO (Multiresolution UNified DOwnscaling), a generative framework for temporal downscaling under general linear observation operators. MUNDO introduces a null-space parameterization that enforces exact observation consistency in a single network evaluation, unifying temporal interpolation and disaggregation. To capture complex multiscale dynamics, we leverage reverse Markov learning to factorize the observation operator into a hierarchy of successive coarsenings. translated_title: MUNDO：一个用于时间降尺度的多分辨率生成式框架
translated_abstract: 动力系统通常以粗时间分辨率通过稀疏状态或时间聚合的方式进行观测，这使得潜在的细尺度轨迹无法被解析。恢复这些轨迹需要既能捕捉未解析的变异性、又与观测保持一致的概率模型。我们提出了MUNDO（Multiresolution UNified DOwnscaling，多分辨率统一降尺度），这是一个在一般线性观测算子下进行时间降尺度的生成式框架。MUNDO引入了一种零空间参数化方法，能够在单次网络评估中强制实现精确的观测一致性，从而统一了时间插值与时间分解。为了捕捉复杂的多尺度动力学，我们利用反向马尔可夫学习将观测算子分解为一系列逐步粗化的层级结构，每一层级仅建模相邻分辨率之间损失的自由度。我们在双尺度Lorenz-96系统以及四个二维物理系统上对MUNDO进行了评估。
tldr: MUNDO提出了一种多分辨率生成式时间降尺度框架，通过零空间参数化在单次网络评估中实现精确观测一致性，并利用反向马尔可夫学习分层建模相邻分辨率间损失的自由度，统一了时间插值与时间分解。
en_tdlr: MUNDO is a multiresolution generative framework for temporal downscaling that enforces exact observation consistency in a single network evaluation via null-space parameterization and uses reverse Markov learning to hierarchically model only the degrees of freedom lost between adjacent resolutions, unifying temporal interpolation and disaggregation.
